Prep - Up to 5 minutes

  • Two pieces of whole grain / whole wheat bread (*maybe a third piece if desired)
  • 1/3 cup of egg whites or egg beaters
  • 1/3 cup of organic vanilla soy milk
  • 1/4 teaspoon Greek seasoning
  • 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes or sprinkle with Parmesan cheese  

Cook - Up to 15 minutes or so

  • Using a 8 /10 inch skillet, heat it up with a base of olive oil (I'm using Basil infused) on medium heat
    • and sprinkle minced onion on top of the oil (optional)
  • Whisk the spices, milk, and egg whites together to get a very light froth going
  • Dip the bread (cut the whole pieces in half for better turn-over with a spatula) into the mix; Soak both sides
  • Drop the bread mix into the skillet and cook accordingly (5-10 mins on each side or till golden brown)
  • Use the rest of the mixture for above *third piece of bread or cook as a mini omelet
